boundary_rationale: After the quoted song closes, the poetic voice continues unquoted, opening with a gnomic observation, “The way of the just is uprightness” (web:Isa.26.7), matching אֹ֥רַח לַצַּדִּ֖יק מֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים (oshb:Isa.26.7, byte tier), and turning at once to second-person petition addressed to Yahweh (“we have waited for you” web:Isa.26.8) that persists through the resurrection hope “Your dead shall live.
